verdict.rationale: The CLI supports natural-language extraction queries (`crwl ... -q "Extract all product prices"`) and adaptive crawling that stops based on a natural-language query goal, plus MCP integration letting AI assistants like Claude Code drive it conversationally. However, most other operations (config, deep-crawl flags, session/browser settings) still require explicit parameters/code rather than full NL control. Missing for 10: broader NL command coverage across configuration/session management, independent hands-on evidence of NL-driven workflows beyond the -q flag.
